issues: 纯色 #0d0e13 暗底 + 单层重投影，卡片像贴在黑板上，没有空间关系
商品图是一块深色圆角色块加一根竖线，看不出是什么
文案全是占位（Sample Product Title / Placeholder copy / Category·Subgroup·Detail）
价格降级是同帧硬切：字号、颜色、删除线一帧跳变，读不出“被划掉”
字段落位只有 6px 平移淡入，pop 用 outBack 过冲偏大；高亮是高饱和橙色方块
changes: 暗场柔光底（顶光 + 极淡暖色余光）+ 暗角 + 1920 原生颗粒；卡面微渐变、0.25 设计 px 发丝线与顶部内高光、两层投影 + 地面接触影
商品图改为棚拍渐变底 + 矢量双肩包（提手/拉链/前袋/织标/左上主光边缘高光）+ 双层接触影，图内容 1.06→1 慢收晚于外框落定
出版级虚构内容：品牌眉标 + “Transit Daypack 22L”、Bags/Backpacks/Commuter 面包屑（末级选中态）、三行卖点、色名 Graphite
价格降级改为 6f 急变：旧价 21→14px 变灰 + 删除线从左划过，新价 spring 跳出，f=29 跟一枚 SAVE 24% chip
rise 改强 ease-out + 1.1px→0 失焦淡入，pop 改 overshoot(0.34,1.45,0.64,1)；高亮降到 30% 透明度并做斜切笔头；整卡前推改不对称 in-out
issuesEn: Flat #0d0e13 background with one heavy drop shadow; the card looked pasted on a blackboard
The product image was a dark rounded blob with a vertical line, unreadable as a product
All copy was placeholder (Sample Product Title / Placeholder copy / Category·Subgroup·Detail)
The price downgrade was a same-frame hard cut: size, color and strike all jumped in one frame
Fields only slid 6px; pops used a large outBack overshoot; highlights were saturated orange blocks
changesEn: Dark soft-lit backdrop (top light + faint warm tint), vignette and native-resolution grain; card gets a subtle gradient, 0.25-unit hairline, top inner highlight, two-layer shadow and floor contact shadow
Product image is now a studio sweep with a vector backpack (handle, zips, front pocket, woven tag, top-left rim light) and layered contact shadow; the image content settles 1.06→1 after its frame
Publication-grade fictional content: brand eyebrow, “Transit Daypack 22L”, Bags/Backpacks/Commuter breadcrumb with selected last step, three feature lines, color name Graphite
Price downgrade is now a 6f snap: old price shrinks 21→14px and greys while a strike line draws left-to-right, the new price springs in and a SAVE 24% chip follows at f=29
Rise uses a strong ease-out plus 1.1px→0 defocus fade, pop uses overshoot(0.34,1.45,0.64,1); highlights drop to 30% alpha with a skewed marker tip; the card push uses an asymmetric in-out
